mechanism: Celecoxib (NSAID) may increase mefloquine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while mefloquine's CNS effects may be potentiated; NSAIDs also increase seizure risk and can cause GI complications that complicate antimalarial therapy.
action: Monitor closely for mefloquine adverse effects (neuropsychiatric symptoms, dizziness, seizures); consider alternative analgesic if prolonged mefloquine use; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
